message:
You know that feeling when you’ve been telling the family to prepare for storms, and then one rolls in? It’s like a smug ‘I told you so’ moment. I stumbled upon a handy resource that lays out what to do during thunderstorms and lightning. It’s got all the practical tips you need to stay safe and sound, just in case Mother Nature decides to show off. 

Remember, it’s always better to be prepared than to be caught off guard. Anyone else have a go-to tip for stormy weather?
